tldr: Lilith in Virgo: the shamed body and the rebel against control
body: Lilith in Virgo: the shamed body and the rebel against control. Where you reclaim the right to be imperfect and your own master. Watch: self-criticism turned to contempt. Refusal of imposed standards: you reject the demand to be tidy, useful, or perfect on command. An intuitive read on the link between mind and body; as a child you may have absorbed others' pain physically and learned to override your own signals. When those signals stay ignored, wellbeing suffers; the way back is gentle, embodied care, listening to the body and tending health rather than pushing through.
business: Owned, this is a healthy refusal of other people's impossible bars.
shadow: Suppressed it turns into harsh self-criticism; unchecked, contempt for others' standards.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Imported from approved project Black Moon Lilith material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
